cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your coat off. The prophecy says this bell-less tower will ring at noon; I need a witness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sign that before you go. I'll fill in our names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me four more minutes. I'll bring the form to the door so you can leave at noon.

reason: Keep exact corrected-time arithmetic; A takes form work and makes departure easier while preserving the witness until noon, without explaining the mechanism.
